title: Run record
description: One JSON line per agent run, appended by the runner (never the agent). Exactly the line agentic-template's scripts/loop.mjs writes to .agent/loop-runs.jsonl; promptbook fields are optional additions. A run is an author's unless role says otherwise: an evaluator's run ends in a verdict and a reader's in a read, neither of which moves the task.

task.description: The workflow task id (<PREFIX>-<n>) when the work has one; otherwise the runtime's stable id, as task-record.task_id and return.task accept (a review of an outside pull request, a delegated job).

exit.description: Process exit code, or the signal name when the process was killed by one.

outcome.description: advanced: the dispatched task left ready/in-progress. stalled: it did not, or another task was claimed. failed: non-zero exit, error result, or no parseable result. needs-human: it did not advance after a denied tool call (scripts/loop.mjs since it pins dontAsk). verdict: an evaluator's run that judged the task's criteria. read: a reader's or helper's run that answered a question. Neither verdict nor read moves the task; the status it was in is the status it keeps.

role.description: Promptbook: the session's part in the task. Absent: the author (the loop's coder run). evaluator and reader runs end in verdict and read.

subtype.description: The engine's result subtype (Claude Code: success, error_max_turns, error_max_budget_usd, error_during_execution, error_max_structured_output_retries), or null when no result was parsed. Mapped to attention in state-machines/attention.yaml.

usage.description: Promptbook: the run's tokens over every model it called. input is what neither came from nor went to the prompt cache; cache_read and cache_write are what did, absent when the engine does not report them. null when the result reported none.

status_after.description: The task's workflow status read back from the task file after the run, or null if the file was gone.

runtime.description: Promptbook: the runner that wrote the line (claude-loop, ci, stagehand).

permission_denials.description: Denied tool calls: a count, or one line per call (tool: what it was pointed at), as scripts/loop.mjs writes since it pins dontAsk. Non-empty means a question for a human (ADR-0021).

allOf.description: A failed, stalled or needs-human run carries its reason; an advanced, verdict or read run has none.
A verdict is an evaluator's run.
A read is a reader's or helper's run.
advanced means the dispatched task left ready and in-progress (scripts/loop.mjs stall()).
